verdict.rationale: The evidence shows n8n ships its own trigger nodes. There is a documented Webhook node, a hands-on report of webhook-initiated tasks, and a community mention of a Kafka trigger node, all alongside 1500+ app integrations. However, no evidence shows app-specific event triggers for the story's examples. missing for 10: documented app-event triggers for new records, incoming messages, new email and form submissions; first-party docs detailing trigger behavior (polling vs push); content on the Kafka trigger doc page.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: the kafka trigger node has zero info on its doc page
